_about: Greek and Latin roots for the Word parts section of the Learning card. tag_roots.py finds them in the words and writes word_roots.json (the app reads that file, not this one). Fields: root = how it is shown; lang = Greek | Latin | Greek/Latin; meaning; forms = regexes on the lowercase, accent-free word, tried longest first; at = start (prefix), end (suffix) or any; etyma = regexes on the word's Merriam-Webster history that confirm it; needOrigin = the word's origin must name the root's language; strict = only tag the word when its MW history confirms it (or it is in examples), for short or look-alike roots; common = everyday words with the root, shown in the Roots tab (any words, not only the lists); source = where Scripps lists the root (roots without it were added from general root lists, not from Scripps); examples = words checked by hand (from the 2026 Words of the Champions root tables, pp. 64-67), always tagged. Started 2026-11-18 from the guide's tables, plus common roots found across the word lists; widened the same day to the common Greek and Latin roots, prefixes, suffixes and number roots in general (those are strict: tagged in a word only when its MW history confirms them).
